resources.string: Pick files on your phone, the Games folder and other folders
Tap Add games and pick the files you downloaded to your phone. They show up here with name, cover and info.
Tap Add and pick %1$s games on your phone.
Pick one or more games (Downloads, Drive, memory card). The console is detected automatically; .zip works too.

resources.string: Ready at %1$s. Games copied there show up automatically.
To read the %1$s folder on your phone (where you can put games from a computer), allow file access. Picking files above works without it.
Pick other folders on your phone or memory card. Games are read straight from there.
Tap a profile to change its name, avatar or color
